stance_basis: listed among additional commenters submitting opposition to the proposed Airport Spur Highway Project
summary: Wisconsin's Environmental Decade, represented by Thomas R. Burney, submitted comments opposing the proposed Airport Spur Highway Project and requested that their comments be included in the Final Environmental Impact Statement. The organization appears in the document as one of several additional commenters whose letters are contained in Section X of the EIS. No detailed summary of their specific objections is provided in this window of the document.
